title: StoryWeaver
perItem: each story's own licence: `licenseType` in its record, or the licence line on its attribution page; a story under any other licence is refused until this record lists it

terms.quotation: The license that has been used for all stories and images is the CC BY 4.0 license.
terms.attribution: '<title>' written by <author>, illustrated by <illustrator>, published by <publisher> under a CC BY 4.0 license on StoryWeaver.

caveats: the public story record (api/v1/stories/<slug>) carries title, language, level, authors, illustrators and publisher, but no page text
page text is served to a signed-in reader only (api/v1/stories/<slug>/read answers 401 without an account)
read-alongs and videos may carry other licences
unverified: the licence of read-alongs and videos (a search result said CC BY-NC-ND 4.0)
